description.en: Being polite and getting things done: requests, commands and bans, phone calls, advice, and cancelling or confirming
description.es-419: Ser cortés y resolver asuntos: peticiones, órdenes y prohibiciones, llamadas, consejos, y cancelar o confirmar
description.it: Essere cortesi e sbrigare le cose: richieste, ordini e divieti, telefonate, consigli, annullare e confermare
